title: Dataset Split Module Compiler
description: Compiles dataset splitting logic. Enforces split-before-transform ordering, stratified splits for classification, reproducible random state, no test set contamination, and correct temporal/group splits for time-series data.

error_codes.SP002: Transforms (fit/transform) applied before train/test split — data leakage
error_codes.SP003: No random_state set in train_test_split — split is not reproducible
error_codes.SP004: Test set accessed or transformed before final evaluation
error_codes.SP005: Classification task without stratify= parameter — class imbalance not preserved
error_codes.SP006: Time-series data not using TimeSeriesSplit or sorted chronological split
error_codes.SP007: Train/val/test ratios not documented in spec
